WELCOME TO DART MEADOW
JOURNEY OF THE SKYBOARD

Play as a guest, or sign in with GitHub to get your own private jots-<you> repository that keeps your saves and loads them for you on any device.

Either way you can play Story on your own or join Multiplayer, one shared world with everyone online. In multiplayer, other players see your pilot name, your board and where you fly, and read what you type in chat.

To keep the LEATR network and its Session Cubes alive, the game sends anonymous gameplay events (landings, travel, discoveries), never your name, account, chat or location. Details: Privacy Policy.

Guests keep saves on this device (plus Save / Export / Import). You can sign in later from the menu.
